Cipher_Group (object)
Configures a Cipher Group
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
allowCipherRules
array
{“bigip”:”/Common/f5-default”}
Allow the following Cipher Rules.
class*
string
“Cipher_Group”
excludeCipherRules
array
Exclude the following Cipher_Rules from the Allowed list.
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
order
string
“default”
“default”, “speed”, “strength”, “fips”, “hardware”
Configure the order of the specified Cipher Rules.
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
requireCipherRules
array
Restrict the Allowed list to the following Cipher_Rules.
